explication: AutoShorts is a local-first desktop studio for turning recordings into ranked vertical-clip candidates. The main workflow is to import a recording into a project, extract audio and transcribe it, detect and rank moments, then render portrait clips with captions for export. The UI invokes a Tauri Rust backend; project data is persisted locally. README-described onboarding, provider configuration, YouTube download, and environment warnings are included. Some domain links rely on README descriptions because the backend excerpts are incomplete; those are marked as documented rather than inferred from unsampled calls.
